insight: Fairly Trained certified — its 'maestro' model trains on licensed music with musicians paid, so output is ethically-sourced royalty-free.
name: Beatoven.ai
tagline: Royalty-free AI music generator for video, podcasts, and games.
description: An AI music generator that crafts royalty-free background tracks from a text description via its 'maestro' model, with support for video and audio prompts and sound-effects generation. Every download carries a non-exclusive perpetual license for monetized use. It is Fairly Trained certified, meaning its training data is licensed and contributing musicians are compensated.

modelSupport.notes: Uses Beatoven's own 'maestro' model, trained on licensed music; no model picker.
